title: Documents touted by Trump say election systems 'would be difficult to manipulate'
script: Here is what viewers need to know right now. Reports are focusing on this development: Documents touted by Trump say election systems 'would be difficult to manipulate'. In simple words, Declassified documents touted by President Trump during his election address cast doubt on some of his claims about "shocking vulnerabilities" in the election system Some details may change as more information becomes available, so viewers should check trusted news sources for the newest update.
